annotations.text:
Five directions for a daily expenses dashboard, all on the same sample day (Sat 12 Sep, 9 entries, MVR 3,480).

A Ledger: sister of the Ike Sales screen. Total, bars by category group, list of entries.
B Dark dial: glanceable. Spend against a daily cap, sales / expenses / net, category tiles.
C Paper ledger: the staff category sheet turned into a daily statement. Codes, hairline bars, totals rule.
D Share strip: analytical. Share of spend, expenses as % of sales, the week so far.
E Timeline feed: the filing flow. Entries by time of day, week heat strip, one Add button.

Pick one and the final builds into Main.
